Class GuiAssets

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.View.GUI.GuiAssets
public final class GuiAssets extends Object
Centralised access to GUI image assets.

Provides a process-wide Image cache (so the same PNG is decoded once, as mandated by the GUI rules) and the mapping from a player's TotemColor to the matching totem artwork bundled under /cards/totem/.

Two totem styles ship with the game: an angled 3-D render (files Livello 17-21) used for prominent spots such as the players strip, and a flat front view (Livello 12-16) used for small markers on the board tiles and the turn-order rail.
